serverInfo.name: weftcut
serverInfo.title: WeftCut
serverInfo.description: The WeftCut desktop video editor exposed as an MCP tool surface. Around 66 tools, resources and prompts cover the full editing vocabulary: import and place clips, trim, split, keyframes with bezier easing, per-layer effect chains, chroma key, captions, Motif overlays, markers, checkpoints and undo. Calls land in the running editor's UI in real time, so a human can watch and audit every edit as the agent makes it. No public release exists yet; version 0.0.0 means unreleased, not unversioned.

transport.endpointNote: This server is not hosted. It runs inside the WeftCut desktop app, binds to loopback only, and picks a port at startup, so no fixed public endpoint exists. The app's Settings -> Agent panel prints the ready-to-paste client config with the live port and bearer token. Requests are bearer-authenticated and protected against DNS rebinding.

authentication.note: Per-install token generated by the app and shown in Settings -> Agent. There is no authorization server and no token endpoint to discover.
